prerequisites: Vorkenntnisse aus: der Vorlesung "Thermodynamik I" mit Grundlagen zur Energieerhaltung und Kreisprozessberechnung.
Vorkenntnisse aus: der Vorlesung "Thermodynamik II" mit Grundlagen der Wärmetransportprozessen und Berechnung von Wärmeübertrager.

learning_outcomes.text: Name and interpret framework conditions for thermal management.
Describe the state of humid air and graphically represent and analytically calculate how it can be changed.
Reproduce the classic system layout of thermal management for different drive concepts and describe the function of the components contained.
Identify current challenges in conventional and electrified powertrain technology, considering thermal boundary conditions.
Name refrigerant requirements and explain the function and operating mode of the components integrated into the refrigerant circuit.
Create a demand-driven design of heating and cooling capacity using the example of a passenger car cabin air conditioning system and verify it through a 1D simulation.

syllabus_topics: Thermal management of conventional vehicles with internal combustion engines (Chapter 1)
Transferable heat flow of the cooling system (Chapter 2)
Heat pump function and alternative refrigerants (Chapter 4)
Humid air: state variables and processes (Chapter 2)
Main components of air conditioning systems (Chapter 3)
Simulation of thermal air conditioning systems (Chapter 4)
